items.title: X Password Reset Surge Signals Possible Security Issue
points: X users have been receiving waves of unsolicited password reset emails for weeks, with a major surge occurring on September 1st
The platform has not disclosed or confirmed any recent data breach despite the widespread reports
A similar incident happened to Instagram in January after a dataset leaked on the dark web
Crypto Twitter users face heightened risk: prominent accounts could be hijacked by phishers, as occurred with the official BNB Chain account last year

X introduced auto-locking and account verification measures earlier in 2026 for accounts posting about cryptocurrency for the first time, but this offers limited protection if accounts are already compromised

items.title: Crypto Industry Investment and Regulatory Activity
points: Ark Invest purchased $37 million in Bitcoin-related assets: 456,059 shares of Block across three ETFs and $3.4 million in Circle stock

MicroStrategy CEO Michael Saylor urged MSCI (an index provider whose benchmarks are tracked by many investment funds) to drop a proposed rule that would remove three companies from its global indexes in November, calling it 'discriminatory,' with MicroStrategy being the largest affected firm

Hyperliquid, a decentralized exchange (a non-custodial trading platform where users retain control of their funds), is in talks with Kraken's parent company to bring perpetual futures (leveraged derivative contracts allowing traders to speculate on price movements) to U.S. traders

items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Outperforming Stock Market Benchmarks
points: IBIT (BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF, a fund that trades on stock exchanges and tracks Bitcoin's price) has delivered higher returns than VOO (Vanguard's S&P 500 ETF) since IBIT's launch, showing Bitcoin's strong recent performance relative to broad stock market indices

Continued inflows into U.S. Bitcoin ETFs reflect growing adoption of cryptocurrency investment through regulated, traditional financial infrastructure, particularly among investors who prefer ETF structures over direct Bitcoin ownership

issues.subject: 🚀 BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF Is Beating the S&P 500

headlines: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) has outperformed Vanguard's top S&P 500 ETF since its launch, signaling strong investor appetite for cryptocurrency exposure through traditional investment vehicles.
U.S. Bitcoin ETFs continue attracting fresh inflows, indicating sustained institutional and retail interest in regulated Bitcoin investment products.

sections.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Outperforming Stock Market Benchmarks
points: 1. IBIT (BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF) has delivered higher returns than VOO (Vanguard's S&P 500 ETF) since IBIT's launch, demonstrating Bitcoin's strong recent performance relative to broad stock market indices.

2. Continued inflows into U.S. Bitcoin ETFs reflect growing adoption of cryptocurrency investments through regulated, traditional financial infrastructure, particularly among investors who prefer ETF structures over direct Bitcoin ownership.
